title: Routing experiment
subtitle: Train the learned router on routed runs, watch it beside the rules router, and promote it only when the gate agrees.

unavailable.title: Router + Fusion is off
unavailable.body: Turn on a Router + Fusion surface under Settings → AI connections → Routing. Without routed runs there is nothing to learn from.

reason.input_unavailable: stored input is gone or unreadable

report.title: Report
report.empty: No experiment has been run yet.

gateRefusal.DETERMINISTIC_LOGGING: Every run was routed by the deterministic rules router, so no comparison is identifiable.
gateRefusal.NO_PREDICTOR: No head could be published, so there was no candidate to compare against.

report.noClaim: This report makes no claim about real quality, cost or saving.

shadow.title: Shadow decisions
shadow.note: The learned router predicts beside the rules router and never acts on the result.
shadow.empty: No shadow decision has been recorded yet.
shadow.noPredictor: No learned router is active, so there is nothing to shadow.
shadow.refused: The active manifest could not be verified and was not used.

promotion.title: Learned router
promotion.none: None — the rules router decides every route.
promotion.dormant: Later release: a promoted predictor is recorded and shadowed, and does not change a routing decision yet.
promotion.deactivated: The learned router is off again

refused.SIMULATED_REPORT: A simulated report never promotes anything: it met no real request and spent no real money.
refused.NO_PUBLISHED_MANIFEST: No head was calibrated on independent data, so there is nothing to publish.
refused.GATE_NOT_PASSED: The promotion gate did not pass.
refused.FEATURES_VERSION_MISMATCH: The manifest was trained on a different feature encoding than this build uses.
